Inaugural Meeting 03.06.2026
The first meeting of the Cologne Skill Space was full success. More than three people showed up and that doesn’t include the organizers.
Following a general discussion about what the CSS could be, Dr. Albert Deuker held a presentation about Newell’s famous constraints paper. After a dicussion about to what extent this framework is usefull as a scientific theory.
